from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from cassandra.cluster import Session
import asyncio

router = APIRouter(prefix="/fleet/devices")

@router.get("/{device_hwid}/health-history")
async def get_device_health_history(
    device_hwid: str,
    session: Session = Depends(get_cassandra_session),
    tech: Technician = Depends(get_technician),
    fleet_svc: FleetService = Depends(get_fleet_service)
):
    device = await fleet_svc.get_device_by_hwid(device_hwid)
    if not device:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Device HWID not found")
    if device.client_id != tech.client_id and not tech.is_super_tech:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: technician lacks access to this client device")

    cql = "SELECT log_timestamp, cpu_temp, battery_percentage, fault_code FROM device_health WHERE device_hwid = %s LIMIT 20"
    future = session.execute_async(cql, (device_hwid,))
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    items = await loop.run_in_executor(None, future.result)

    return [
        {"time": r.log_timestamp.isoformat(), "cpu_temp": r.cpu_temp, "battery": r.battery_percentage, "fault": r.fault_code}
        for r in items
    ]
